title: Reopen carries only portable bindings once environment pins are gone
outcome: A reopened item's bindings can all be satisfied on its new run: with environment pins removed from verification requirements, reopen carries only portable bindings.
acceptance: It is delivered in the same changeset as the removal of environment pins, whose required gates and both reviews pass.

With environment pins removed, reopen carries only portable bindings: a test reopens a completed item whose criterion is bound to a pinned check (check_fingerprint), and the new run's obligation is satisfied by a passing host verification of that check.

completion.summary: Reopen carries only portable bindings.
